notes.title: ARCADE game mode
notes.content:
We have listened to your feedback, and we have set the Arcade mode as the primary game mode, which is the one you like the most. 
Now you can enjoy this game mode as the primary game mode. But also, you will not have to do without the script, and you will be able to use the ship as the main character.

For those who prefer the previous mode: The previous story mode is accessible from options, as well as if you want to play with Novichiva in Arcade mode. We have not removed anything.

We have also taken the opportunity to make several improvements, such as having the immersion zones available directly from the menu. 

We hope that all these changes are to your liking. We have made them with a lot of love and passion.

notes.content:
It's been a few months of hard work improving the game thanks to the feedback received and creating things as spectacular as the new ARCADE mode.

https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4504829629531931

Thank you very much to everyone who has made the game possible and we hope to continue to improve it.

notes.title: New ARCADE game mode with the intense experience closest to the arcade classics
notes.content:
We released the game in Early access to listen to your feedback and use it to improve the game. The new arcade mode results from this feedback, and we must confess that we LOVE it.
In the new Arcade mode, you will find a much more direct experience and closer to the experience of playing the classic arcades: Without view changes and with more "retro" mechanics. But using Virtual Reality to experience the game from within.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40315956/64a7d34f884797b21d48f4a19d340cc16a4d92fe.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Retry the boss, control preferences, and more
notes.content:
- Now, you can retry the boss one time (except in the extreme difficulty mode) by inserting the coins accumulated in the game.
- If you choose the same control preference in the immersion zones three times in a row, you will not be asked again.
- Improvements in the optional motion control mode, designed for non-stick controls (Vive wand).
- Bug fixes

notes.title: Various improvements and bug fixes
notes.content:
- The laser shots in the level don't kill you now in one touch (except for the boss).
- Improved game-ending (although the surprise is not ready yet).
- Rearview sensitivity adjusted.
- Some graphical improvements.
- Several bug fixes.

notes.title: Quest demo released and huge version updates!
notes.content:
We have released the Oculus Quest native version of the 2076 Demo and we have also added many important new features that we have been able to realize thanks to your great feedback:
[list]
[*] Now you can choose the difficulty at which you want to play each level to satisfy all types of players.
[*] Better control of the ship in immersion zones.
[*] The entry points of the immersion zones are visually clearer.
[*] Fixed some small bugs.
[/list]
Download the Quest version here: 
https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4504829629531931

notes.title: We've made a big update to the VR DEMO of 2076 Midway Multiverse
notes.content:
We've made a big update to the #VR #DEMO of 2076 Midway Multiverse:
[list]
[*]  Better lighting and fog effects.
[*]  Better explanation of how the novel virtual shield works with the right hand.
[*]  Improved control in immersion zones: now the ship responds better to turns.
[*]  Improved control with the grip-3D.
[*]  Now you can check the games of the Nostalgia-VR arcade from the screen of each arcade.
[*]  Adjusted and improved some camera changes.
[/list]
